title: SvelteKit 3
summary: SvelteKit 3 is a major release of the popular Svelte web application framework, bringing significant updates aligned with Svelte 5's new runes API and improvements to the full-stack development experience.
problem_solved: Provides an updated, more powerful framework for building modern web applications with improved reactivity and developer experience.
why_valuable: SvelteKit 3 represents a major step forward for the Svelte ecosystem, offering tighter integration with Svelte 5's runes-based reactivity system.
